sources.title: naver/splade-cocondenser-ensembledistil · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is a SPLADE Sparse Encoder model. It maps sentences & paragraphs to a 30522-dimensional sparse vector space and can be used for semantic search and sparse retrieval.

sources.title: GitHub - hopit-ai/Moda: MODA: open fashion retrieval benchmark and ...
sources.snippet: MODA is an open-source benchmark and model family for fashion retrieval, built by Hopit AI. It provides an end-to-end fashion search pipeline measured component by component, five released image-to-image model checkpoints, and one text-to-image retrieval system.

sources.title: splade-cocondenser-ensembledistil by naver, Feature Extraction ...
sources.snippet: On Mixpeek, splade-cocondenser-ensembledistil runs as a managed extractor inside a processing pipeline. Point a bucket of feature extraction data at it, and Mixpeek handles GPU provisioning, batching, retries, and writing the outputs into a vector store you can query.
